text.tspan: A container = a normal process + namespaces + cgroups
pid: own process tree from PID 1
User namespace off → root in the container
is UID 0 on the host → run as non-root
Also: capabilities (Docker keeps ~14 of ~40) · seccomp (blocks dangerous syscalls) · AppArmor / SELinux.
Modern Linux uses cgroup v2. Kubernetes limits become exactly these cgroup settings on the node.
